template.name: Supertrend Hombrok Bot
template.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high,{p0}) and volume_ratio(volume,{p1}) > {p0} and (close - open) > {p1} * atr(high,low,close,{p2}) and rsi(close,14) < 70
template.notes: The Supertrend state is proxied by a 10-bar upside break (AtrPeriod=10 as the lookback) while the documented filters are exact: VolumeMultiplier=1.2, BodyPctOfAtr=0.3, and RsiOverbought=70. The ATR(10) x 3.0 band below price is the documented ATR-based stop exit; the take profit, RiskRewardRatio=2, and CapitalPerTrade sizing are not percent fields.
